card.name: Spaces before dose numbers in tables
card.fires_on: Mostly a blank space or small joining piece right before a dose number or next list item, in clinical-trial tables and dose lists. Often follows a drug name or a dose such as '1 mg/day' and comes before the next dose column.

modes.label: Space between dose columns
modes.description: A space after one dose arm and before the next dose in a results table.

modes.label: Space after drug name before dose
modes.description: A space after a drug name that comes just before a dose range.

modes.label: Inside list or drug name
modes.description: A spot inside a number, section list, or drug name, such as a digit in a dose or a piece of a drug name.
